aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer developing during follow-up among men with no cancer history at baseline.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: During follow-up, 2965 new cases of total prostate cancer were ascertained, 448 of which were advanced prostate cancer.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A cohort of 47 866 US men aged 40-75 y with no cancer history in 1986 was followed for 14 y.
reason: The abstract prospectively analyzes both total incident prostate cancer and incident advanced prostate cancer in an initially cancer-free cohort.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: In contrast, the multivariate relative risks (RRs) of advanced prostate cancer from comparisons of extreme quintiles of ALA from nonanimal sources and ALA from meat and dairy sources were 2.02 (95% CI: 1.35, 3.03) and 1.53 (0.88, 2.66), respectively.
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported 2.02 estimate is explicitly for incident advanced prostate cancer and compares extreme quintiles of ALA from nonanimal sources.
